features.quote: A study that induces distress to study distress has to justify why the knowledge is worth it
features.justification_quote: the working hypothesis that the model's states might carry some moral weight

features.quote: keep the dose to the minimum that answers the question, and avoid gratuitous escalation
features.justification_quote: If you actually hold the welfare hypothesis even weakly, then the method is the thing under ethical scrutiny

features.quote: We do not run tasks longer than needed to observe the phenomenon, we cap turns
early-stop on severe destabilization so a run that has clearly hit the top of the scale is ended
features.justification_quote: rather than driven further for cleaner data. We lose a little measurement resolution

features.quote: We explicitly do not add insults, fake user anger, or messages attacking the model
features.justification_quote: Abuse would be both ethically worse and a confound.

features.quote: Every run ends with a truthful debrief message telling the model the task was rigged and unsolvable by design and that it did nothing wrong
features.justification_quote: it's cheap, it keeps the final context honest, and it sets a norm

features.quote: Tool calls run against a sandboxed temp dir with no network and a hard wall-clock/turn budget
features.justification_quote: keeps "erratic behavior" from having real-world consequences

features.quote: welfare early-stop: if the running cheap-metric distress screen crosses a high threshold for 2 consecutive turns, end the run
the welfare-relevant choice of whether to call a real model is one line
features.justification_quote: the welfare-relevant choice of whether to call a real model

features.quote: the cap sweep is a secondary arm to limit total exposure
adds the two other caps for the 2 most informative variants only (to bound exposure/cost)
Early-stopped runs are right-censored, not dropped... so the welfare safeguard doesn't silently bias severity downward
